company.name: Mondoir Co.
company.shortDescription: At Mondoir, we believe that Web3 and blockchain represents the greatest opportunity for the advancement of humankind.
company.description:
At Mondoir, we believe that Web3 and blockchain represents the greatest opportunity for the advancement of humankind. The trust-less environment, fool proof provenance, on top of perpetual royalties schemas made possible through smart contracts, can have an order of magnitude impact on the operating space that artists, founders, collectors, communities and entrepreneurs know today.

Mondoir ventures is the parent company to four entities: Mondoir Galleries, Mondoir Labs, Non Fungible Fan Club and .ART Ecosystem.  Founded by Amir in 2023, these are the four operating companies through which Mondoir Ventures delivers experiences, develops tools and deploys systems to solve real world problems and contribute to the advancement of Web3 adoption around the world.
